verdict.rationale: Browser-based, install-free session viewing or control is a fair axis for a remote-desktop product, so it applies. However, the evidence pack documents no web client. The my.anydesk portal and REST API cover account management, session history and closing sessions, not viewing or controlling a session in a browser. The CLI and Customer/Service modules all require installing or running an executable.

support.subject: As a power user, someone can view or control a session from a plain browser with nothing installed
